finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: elapsedTimeSeconds is attacker-controlled and can be manipulated to inject malicious commands
finding.assumptions: The code does not actually execute any commands, but the output could be redirected or logged in a way that an attacker could exploit

finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.trigger: If damagePerTick is very large, it could cause an overflow when cast to int
finding.assumptions: The values of damagePerTick are not expected to be extremely large, but there is no explicit check

finding.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
finding.trigger: The activationCooldown is hard-coded to 1.0, which could be a security risk if it needs to be configurable
finding.assumptions: The activationCooldown should be configurable or derived from a secure source
